bio.text: James Sanders Jr. has represented New York State Senate District 10 since taking office on January 1, 2013.
Ballotpedia lists him as the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Ballotpedia says his professional experience includes serving on the New York City Council since 2002, representing the 31st District, and that term limits prevented him from running for re-election in 2012.
According to Ballotpedia, he graduated from Far Rockaway High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Brooklyn College in 1984, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps.
